description: Two reactions with an arc between them: intrigue at the top, delight after the payoff. The opener carries the template's identity and is required; the second is optional, so a thin reaction library still produces a video rather than nothing.

slots.notes: Opens on intrigue — the 'wait, what?' beat that earns the next two seconds. Emotions are set on the slot rather than taken from the brief's mood, because this template needs two different ones.
The product moment, placed where the answer to the opening question belongs.

Delight, resolving the opener. Optional: with 17 performances and only a couple tagged happy, a missing match should cost this beat rather than the whole video. Selection already refuses to reuse the opener's clip, and refuses any clip sharing its checksum — which matters here because a performance filed under both surprised and excited would otherwise qualify for both slots.
The dish, closing on the thing itself.

captions.pattern: Find it in Big City Travel Guide
